answer: A newcomer earns standing only when judges from three separate branches each lock basalt behind it. Cedar groups keys whose challenge replies share latency fingerprints, and pigment records which branch backed which group. A branch's n-th backing inside one cedar group locks 5n basalt, forfeited if any member fakes work. An honest newcomer costs each branch 5 basalt. An operator's 100 clones in one group need each branch to lock 25,250 basalt, so it must bribe unrelated judges to risk that sum or host each clone on its own network path.
